بَرِّيمَةٌ , with fet-h, and with teshdeed to the ر which is meksoorah, A دَائِرَة [or feather, or portion of the hair naturally curled or frizzled, in a spiral manner, or otherwise,] upon a horse, whereby one judges of its goodness or badness: pl. بَرَارِيمُ. (TA: [and used in this sense in the present day.]) ―
-b2- See also بَيْرَمٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
